text:
Predicates:
Season(x) ::: x is a season in a year.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
FavoriteSeason(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
LoveMost(x, y) ::: x loves y the most.
LongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ LongVacation(x) → LoveMost(x, Summer)) ::: All students who want to have a long vacation love summer the most.
FavoriteSeason(emma, Summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
FavoriteSeason(mia, y) ∧ y ≠ FavoriteSeason(emma, y) ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
LongVacation(james) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.
Conclusion:
FavoriteSeason(james, Summer) ::: James's favorite season is summer.
